name: Special Meeting of the Conceptual Development Review Committee
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this special meeting of the City Council has been called by the
Mayor pursuant to Government Code section 54956. Members of the public may provide
public comments in-person or by submitting an email by 7:30 a.m. to
publiccomments@cityofartesia.us on the date of the meeting.

SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CONCEPTUAL DEVELOPMENT REVIEW COMMITTEE

  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CA 90701  REVISED
  (562) 865-6262

  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 13, 2024
  9:00 A.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

1. Vacant Lot, Vacant Building, and Foreclosed Properties Ordinance Review
  Presentation  Document 1 Document 2

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS
Under California law, public comments at special meetings are limited to subjects on the
agenda only.

ADJOURNMENT

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special
assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-
6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are on file in the Office of the
City Clerk and are available for inspection.
